SONG Yao, GUO Heng, ZHANG Chao, SHEN Su\* (Department of Pharmacy, Beijing Friendship Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing 100050)Abstract: Objective To investigate the common comorbidities among patients with primary nephrotic syndrome and screen potential drug interactions with immunosuppressants recommended by the guidelines. Methods Prescriptions for patients with primary nephrotic syndrome in Beijing Friendship Hospital from 1st January to 30th June 2019 were analyzed. The potential interactions between immunosuppressants for primary nephrotic syndrome and those for the comorbidities recommended by the guidelines were screened with Lexicomp interaction database. Results Major comorbidities among patients with primary nephrotic syndrome were hypertension, osteoporosis, hyperlipoidemia and chronic gastritis. There were 267 interactions (including C, D, and X class interactions) in total. Among these interactions, 234 were C class (87.64%), 18 were D class (6.74%), and 15 were X class (5.62%). Conclusion Primary nephrotic syndrome patients with comorbidities may need therapy consisting of multiple drugs.
